summary.text: Ed Hooper represents District 21 in the Florida Senate, to which Hooper was elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Hooper served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2006 to 2014 and as a Clearwater city commissioner from 1996 to 2000.
Hooper is a retired firefighter and a partner at Consus Group, LLC. Hooper was born in Statesville, North Carolina, moved to Florida in 1972, and attended Saint Petersburg College.
